irene: dropped a quick summary from today's earlystream merge probe on ember-13b-quant. included numbers + a short eval/playbook.

joel: what is 'earlystream merge' vs prefill/warmstart?

irene: we stream a provisional prefix from a cheap quant, but instead of full replace we compute a tokenizer-overlap score and do logit-interp weighted merge using an alignment penalty. idea: reduce wrong-entity swaps by preferring tokens with high BPE-overlap.

marta: metrics? local dev A40 run.

ops-bot: perf snapshot:
```
cheap(3b-4bit) p50/token 10ms
main(13b-4bit) p50/token 25ms
earlystream M=6 -> client-ttfb p50 ~60ms vs baseline ~150ms
p95 short end2end -29%
```

joel: quality?

irene: 450-sample mixed holdout: EM-like down 0.7% absolute, embed-cos -0.008. human AB (80 pairs): earlystream preferred 26%, baseline 58%, tie 16%. notable: entity name mangles dropped vs naive prefill. tokenizer-overlap heuristic cut those by ~45%.

marta: mitigation knobs tried?

irene: (1) tokenizer-overlap threshold (only merge if overlap>0.6), (2) subword-alignment penalty when interpolating logits, (3) conservative-streaming for punctuation/reserved tokens only. combo gave good quality/latency balance.

joel: runtime impl notes?

irene: need provisional_stream flag, ephemeral logits store, merge_on_confirm endpoint that does atomic KV swap and emits patch delta. also trace spans earlystream/start earlystream/merge.

logbot: config snippet:
```
--early-m=6 --cheap=ember-mini-3b-4bit --overlap-min=0.6 --interp-alpha=0.25 --symkl-thresh=0.14
```

marta: telemetry + rollout?

irene: ship: attempts, streamed, merged, aborts, merge_overlap_hist, patch_rate, regen_count, latency p50/p95. rollout: A/B sandbox 0.5% -> 1% -> ramp with auto-disable if patch_rate>7% or route-pref-proxy drop>4% over 12h.

joel: eval plan?

irene: 6k stratified holdout + 1k tokenization adversariality (emails, company names, hyphens). run 4 configs: overlap-high, overlap-low, interp-alpha variants, token-only. metrics: EM/ROUGE/embed/human N=700, patch examples report.

marta: ok i'll enqueue runs. irene, push configs + small README to spec branch and share results.

irene: will do, ping when runs complete. :rocket:
